cases.request: Generate a fixed-base branching manipulator with revolute and prismatic joints, joint-space PD effort control, encoder feedback, and bounded joint-position requirements.
Generate a floating differential-drive mobile robot with two driven wheels, wheel encoders, planar odometry, a lidar, and collision geometry for a ground plane and obstacles.
Generate a free-base quadrotor with four thrust actuators, rigid-body pose and twist, an IMU, altitude feedback, gravity, and a PID attitude controller.
Generate a floating-base quadruped with spherical hip joints, revolute knee joints, foot contact sensing, terrain collision, and a joint trajectory controller.
Generate a free-base underwater vehicle with body-wrench thrusters, depth and IMU sensing, buoyancy and drag dynamics, and a depth-hold controller.
Generate a gripper and object scene with finger joints, contact-force sensing, frictional materials, collision requirements, and an impedance controller for a grasp task.
Generate a six-axis robot following a time-indexed joint trajectory with PID plus velocity feedforward, effort saturation, settling-time, and overshoot requirements.
Generate a four-bar closed-chain mechanism with revolute joints, loop-closure constraints, a motor input, encoder observation, and range-of-motion requirements.
Generate a rigid robot carrying an IMU, camera, lidar, and wheel encoders, with an estimator that outputs fused pose and velocity and requirements on update rate and error bounds.
Generate a prismatic hydraulic actuator with valve flow, chamber pressures, piston force, end stops, position sensing, and closed-loop position control.
Generate a geared electric joint with motor voltage, current, rotor speed, output torque, encoder feedback, thermal state, and current-limited PID control.
Generate a tendon-driven continuum robot with cable tension, deformation state, tip-pose sensing, obstacle contact, and a custom shape controller.
Generate two mobile robots sharing an environment, each with a floating base, lidar and odometry, collision avoidance, and a relative-distance coordination requirement.
